The '''Pirik system''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Divis Arm/Legends|Divis Arm]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pirik]] and a number of other [[Death/Legends|dead]] planets.

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] tried to raid it in the [[Attack on the Pirik system|attacks to Corint City]].
